summary: Two alternate production-progress paths were checked. The Codex no-auth Vercel fallback endpoint is reachable but no longer returns preview/claim deployment URLs, and Docker Desktop remains unable to serve daemon requests after a restart attempt.

notes: A full-repository upload was deliberately not attempted because the generic fallback script ignores .vercelignore and would include owner-local files unless a whitelist package is used.
The slim package excludes published WAV assets, so it is only suitable for checking build/deploy transport, not learning PPT audio acceptance.

reachability.interpretation: Endpoint exists; GET/HEAD is not the deploy method.

postDiagnostic.interpretation: The fallback service no longer creates a claimable preview deployment. It now instructs callers to use Vercel CLI/token/dashboard deployment.

vercelCliOidcRecheck.interpretation: The linked-project production deploy path remains blocked because the Vercel CLI must reach vercel.com OIDC discovery unless a valid classic VERCEL_TOKEN is supplied.

dockerRecoveryAttempt.interpretation: Docker Desktop processes and socket are present, but daemon and Desktop status calls do not complete. Docker-based external-storage production service launch remains unavailable.

nextActions: Use a valid classic VERCEL_TOKEN through a non-logged environment channel, or wait for vercel.com TLS/OIDC reachability to recover, then run the linked production deploy.
Recover Docker Desktop outside the CLI hang condition, then rerun docker ps and the external-storage service launch/smoke.
After deploy/env/storage recovery, rerun production route smoke, teacher workflow live browser smoke, external-storage production smoke, and the aggregate release gate.
